descStruct.observe: トレイルで、静止して置いた 80 個の粒子が自転する中心に引かれて回り出すのを見る(2000 步で内帯 r=6–12 は平均 2.17 rad・外帯 r=18–24 は 0.196 rad)。中心から直接受ける項は遠方で r⁻⁴ で弱まるが、外帯の u の大半は**隣の粒子を通じて届く**(t=0 の診断: 外帯の接線 u は連鎖の解 0.0965・直接の項だけなら 0.00998)。共役勾配法の反復は 2000 步で最大 40 回・残差は許容 1e-10 の内側・未収束 0。dt を半分にしても Δθ は 0.3% 以内。重力は G=0.005 のニュートン(落下は小さい)で、**円盤の形成・回転曲線の再現ではない**。 **長い走行**: 既定の步(semic —— 引きずりの u をドリフトの前の位置で解く)の dt 0.016・t=288 で半径 100 を越えた粒子は 1/80・中央半径 10.6(旧の分割では 80/80・673)—— **既定の刻みの大半の飛びは分割で早まった分**。収束した結合積分 rk4 でも少数の粒子の放出が残る(2/80・中央半径 11.1)。

obsCard.model: toy units; one centre (m=100, uniform sphere of radius 6, spin 0.5, pinned) + 80 particles at rest (m=5, disc radius 6 to 24, seed 20261008); G=0.005 (the fall in 2000 steps is smaller than a band)

inertial chain of geoPN=4: solve (I+L)u=s over the whole system (it reaches particles not directly linked through the ones between); s gets the spinning centre's front/back term m Omega <K_eps (rho.e)> (z x e)/W_bg; x+=u dt (v untouched)

n=81>64 runs the conjugate-gradient solver (network-pcg-v1, diagonal preconditioner); 2000 steps: at most 40 iterations, original-equation residual at most 1.0e-10 (tolerance 1e-10), no failure, no NaN
spin source only, bands r=6-12/12-18/18-24, tangential u: chain solution 0.523/0.180/0.0965; direct term s/(1+deg) 0.214/0.0275/0.00998 (the chain share grows outward)
band means: chain 2.169/0.577/0.196 rad; chain-cut control (centre-particle pairs only) 3.058/0.506/0.0880 rad - outer band 2.22 times

u unchanged by a common translation; spin 0 is bit-identical to no spin source over 200 steps; max 1 iteration leaves u unadopted (state identical to no drag); point receiver's tangential u matches the front/back formula to 2e-15

dt 0.016 vs 0.008: inner-band dTheta 2.169/2.176 rad; largest position difference 0.17. A common rigid rotation does not cancel from s (unlike a translation) - kept, not subtracted (the residual is recorded)
no disc formation, no flat rotation curve, no galaxy; W_bg = 0.125 [M/L^3] (coefficient 1/W_bg = 8) is a declared value (not fitted); only the principle that the chain carries the drag outward

descStruct.summary: A PRINCIPLE SAMPLE OF DRAGGING THAT CHAINS LIKE PACHINKO BALLS STUCK TO A MAGNET (laws: the spin dragging A8 and the transport law E6′, that the geoPN=4 sample implements many-particle dragging chaining like pachinko balls on a magnet). Inner particles dragged by a spinning centre (a uniform sphere) become sources for their neighbours, and the drag chains outward. The chain itself belongs to the existing solve for a COMMON MOVING VELOCITY OVER THE WHOLE SYSTEM ((I+L)u=s, s_i=sum_j m_j K_eps(r_ij)(v_j-v_i)/W_bg - it reaches particles that are not directly linked through the ones between). This wave adds (1) THE FRONT/BACK KERNEL OF A SPINNING SOURCE (spinSource:"surfaceFlip" - the tangential part of the source points' velocity Omega x rho averaged over a uniform sphere; the near and far sides move in opposite directions and the nearer side's larger kernel leaves a remainder - the same form as the earlier front/back kernel, with the inertial-determinacy kernel K_eps) and (2) A SOLVER THAT CHECKS CONVERGENCE WITH MANY PARTICLES (solver:"network-pcg-v1" - the edges c_ij=m_i a_ij are symmetric, so the mass-symmetrised system is solved by conjugate gradients with a diagonal preconditioner; convergence is judged on the original equation, and a step that does not converge is not adopted - the run stops with a notice). There is no extra term adding the neighbours' u again (the same drag is not counted twice).
descStruct.observe: Use the trail to watch 80 particles placed at rest start to turn, pulled by the spinning centre (in 2000 steps the inner band r=6-12 turns 2.17 rad on average, the outer band r=18-24 0.196 rad). The term received directly from the centre falls off as r^-4, yet most of the outer band's u ARRIVES THROUGH THE NEIGHBOURS (diagnostic at t=0: chain solution 0.0965 against 0.00998 from the direct term alone). The conjugate-gradient solver needs at most 40 iterations in 2000 steps, the residual stays inside the 1e-10 tolerance, and no step fails. Halving dt changes dTheta by under 0.3%. Gravity is Newtonian with G=0.005 (the fall is small); THIS IS NOT DISC FORMATION OR A ROTATION CURVE. LONG RUN: with the default step (semic - the drag u solved at the pre-drift position), dt 0.016, t=288: 1/80 particles beyond radius 100, median radius 10.6 (the old split gave 80/80, 673) - MOST OF THE EARLY BLOW-UP AT THE DEFAULT STEP WAS THE SPLIT'S. The converged coupled rk4 still ejects a few (2/80, median 11.1).
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B is THE CHAIN-CUT CONTROL (same declaration with pairs restricted to the 80 centre-particle pairs - no particle-particle edges). On side B the outer band receives only the direct term (dTheta 0.0880 rad in 2000 steps), 0.45 of side A's 0.196 rad. The inner band turns faster on side B (on side A it shares its u with the outer particles it drags). Compare with 🐌 (translational dragging of two bodies - no chain, no spinning source).

descStruct.summary: THE 3D STANDARD SAMPLE OF geoPN=4 (THE MANY-BODY INERTIAL-DETERMINACY MODE) (laws: the spin dragging A8 and the transport law E6′ in 3D; geoPN=4 is the many-body version of the inertial determinacy and 3D is its default). 🔗 chainDiskToy is copied untouched and run with physics.coord 3d. Only the central uniform sphere enables its spin axis (tilt 0 - +z), and the 3D inertial-determinacy declaration relativeDrag.spinDrag adds the ROTATIONAL DRAG (rot surfaceFlip - the source points' velocity Omega a x rho averaged over the uniform sphere gives <K_eps rho> = M1(r) e, hence m Omega M1 (a x e)/W_bg; the cross product carries the sine, so it is largest on the equator and zero on the axis). The TRANSLATIONAL DRAG solves the existing system (I+L)u=s for the x, y and z right-hand sides (same coefficients). No axial drag is declared here (axial off). With the particles on z=0 and the axis along +z the 3D run is bit-identical to the 2D 🔗 (the harness's null test). The space-mesh display is not the legacy physics.spaceMesh but THIS SAMPLE'S INERTIAL-DETERMINACY FIELD (a passive probe: a massless receiver with no reaction at each display point, using the same step's solution u_j and the same kernel - plane Z=0, arrows and frozen-field streamlines), and it shows the vortex round the spinning centre.
descStruct.observe: Turn on the space mesh in the display settings and the arrows and streamlines on the plane Z=0 circle the spinning centre. LONG RUN (x, y bit-identical to 🔗): with the default step (semic - the drag u solved at the pre-drift position), dt 0.016, t=288: 1/80 particles beyond radius 100, median radius 10.6 (the old split gave 80/80, 673) - MOST OF THE EARLY BLOW-UP AT THE DEFAULT STEP WAS THE SPLIT'S. descStruct.summary: **傾いた自転軸の回転引きずりと軸引きずり**の原理サンプル(法則は A8 のスピン引きずりと E6′ の輸送則の三次元・「三次元の慣性決定力: 『回転引きずり』は赤道面で最大・自転軸方向でゼロ。『並進引きずり』『回転引きずり』と別に『軸引きずり』—— 自転軸方向で最大・同じ軸の向きに回転させる・赤道面でゼロ」)。🔩 の写しで、中心の自転軸を +z から 30° 傾ける。回転引きずり m Ω M1(r)(â×ê)/W_bg は粒子の面(z=0)に対して面外の成分を持つので、粒子は回りながら面から浮く。**軸引きずり**(spinDrag の axial:"on")は源の軸の向き â の角速度 ω = A_k m Ω K_ε(r) μ² â を受け手に与え、受け手の**姿勢**(自転軸まわりの角 rotA と、軸を有効化した粒子の軸)を回す —— 線速度 u には足さない。角度則 μ²(両極対称・赤道 0)・距離の核 K_ε(並進と同じ点源)・係数 A_k=4(鍵 axialCoupling)はどれも宣言で、未較正(注記 axial_drag_unfitted)。この本の粒子は傾きを持たない(軸を有効化していない)ので、**傾きを考慮せず**源の寄与 w = A_k m Ω K_ε μ² を符号つきのスカラーのまま引きずり軸回転として回転角に足す(「軸回転 = 慣性軸回転 + 引きずり軸回転」—— 慣性軸回転 s は変えず、引きずり軸回転は毎步作り直す。受け手に傾きは作らない)。軸引きずりの強さも並進・回転と同じ分母で割る —— ν = W_bg/(W_bg + Σw)(受け手の Σw は並進の行和)。

descStruct.summary: A PRINCIPLE SAMPLE OF THE ROTATIONAL AND AXIAL DRAG OF A TILTED SPIN AXIS (laws: the spin dragging A8 and the transport law E6′ in 3D; in 3D the rotational drag is largest on the equator and zero along the spin axis; besides the translational and rotational drag there is an axial drag - largest along the axis, turning bodies about the same axis, zero on the equator). A copy of 🔩 with the centre's axis tilted 30 degrees from +z. The rotational drag m Omega M1(r)(a x e)/W_bg now has a component normal to the particles' plane (z=0), so the particles rise out of the plane while they turn. The AXIAL DRAG (spinDrag axial on) gives each receiver the angular velocity omega = A_k m Omega K_eps(r) mu^2 a along the source axis and turns the receiver's ATTITUDE (the angle rotA about its own axis, and the axis of a body with an enabled axis) - it is never added to the linear velocity u. The angular law mu^2 (symmetric at both poles, zero on the equator), the distance kernel K_eps (the same point kernel as the translation) and A_k=4 (key axialCoupling) are all declarations, uncalibrated (note axial_drag_unfitted). The particles here carry no tilt (no enabled axis), so the source term w = A_k m Omega K_eps mu^2 is added to the rotation angle as a signed scalar, the dragged axial rotation, WITHOUT REGARD TO TILT ((2): axial rotation = inertial axial rotation + dragged axial rotation - the inertial rotation s is unchanged and the dragged rotation is rebuilt every step; no tilt is created on the receiver). The axial drag strength is divided by the same denominator as the translation and rotation - nu = W_bg/(W_bg + sum w) ((5); the receiver's sum w is the translational row sum).

raw.description: **傾いた自転軸の回転引きずりと軸引きずり**の原理サンプル(法則は A8 のスピン引きずりと E6′ の輸送則の三次元・「三次元の慣性決定力: 『回転引きずり』は赤道面で最大・自転軸方向でゼロ。『並進引きずり』『回転引きずり』と別に『軸引きずり』—— 自転軸方向で最大・同じ軸の向きに回転させる・赤道面でゼロ」)。🔩 の写しで、中心の自転軸を +z から 30° 傾ける。回転引きずり m Ω M1(r)(â×ê)/W_bg は粒子の面(z=0)に対して面外の成分を持つので、粒子は回りながら面から浮く。**軸引きずり**(spinDrag の axial:"on")は源の軸の向き â の角速度 ω = A_k m Ω K_ε(r) μ² â を受け手に与え、受け手の**姿勢**(自転軸まわりの角 rotA と、軸を有効化した粒子の軸)を回す —— 線速度 u には足さない。角度則 μ²(両極対称・赤道 0)・距離の核 K_ε(並進と同じ点源)・係数 A_k=4(鍵 axialCoupling)はどれも宣言で、未較正(注記 axial_drag_unfitted)。この本の粒子は傾きを持たない(軸を有効化していない)ので、**傾きを考慮せず**源の寄与 w = A_k m Ω K_ε μ² を符号つきのスカラーのまま引きずり軸回転として回転角に足す(「軸回転 = 慣性軸回転 + 引きずり軸回転」—— 慣性軸回転 s は変えず、引きずり軸回転は毎步作り直す。受け手に傾きは作らない)。軸引きずりの強さも並進・回転と同じ分母で割る —— ν = W_bg/(W_bg + Σw)(受け手の Σw は並進の行和)。トレイルで粒子が回りながら面から浮くのを見る(視点のスライダーを 0 に近づけると横から見える)。表示の「空間メッシュ」を ON にすると Z=0 の面の u の XY への投影と流線、軸引きずりの ω_z を点の色(暖色 +・寒色 −)で出す。ワンタップ対照A/B: B 側は軸引きずりを外す(axial:"off" —— 回転引きずりはそのまま)。B では姿勢の角だけが変わらず、位置と速度は A と同じ(軸引きずりは線速度に足さない)。比べる相手は 🔩(軸 +z)。

raw.description: **円盤を広げた geoPN=4(慣性決定力の多粒子版)の三次元の原理の本**(法則は A8 のスピン引きずりと E6′ の輸送則の三次元 —— 🔩 と同じ・「現状の chainDiskToy 系は、初期配置が集まりすぎている」)。🔩 chainDiskToy3d の宣言(粒子数・質量・半径・G・W_bg・ε・解法・double)を写し、**円盤の配置だけ**を面積一様の環 r=18〜72 に黄金角で置き直した(🔗🔩🪛 の円盤は中心距離 7.55 から始まり、最短の粒子間距離 0.234・宣言半径の重なり 108 組 —— 接触力の無い本なので力ではないが、核 K_ε が最も近い対で決まる配置だった)。中心の自転軸は 30° 傾け(回転引きずりが面外の成分を持つ —— 2000 步で |z| 最大 0.54)、軸引きずりは宣言しない。初速は t=0 の重力の動径成分の釣り合いの**近似の種**(中心と円盤の自己重力を全部足す —— 円盤の総質量 400 は中心の 4 倍。接線の力の残りは打ち消していないので**平衡とは呼ばない**)。**安定の条件は器が先に宣言して測った** 8 項目(配置・連鎖解・停止と再開・三次元の収支・刻み・粒子数・散布の種・表示)で、近似初速の種(A)と零初速(B)の両方で全部を満たした(散布の種の依存は A 5.2%・B 3.7% —— 種の配置も最短距離 ≥ 4 R_p を守る。床を見ない揺らぎでは最短 1.5〜2.5 の対ができ、A の幅は 114% だった —— 速度差の引きずりは最も近い対の 1/r³ で決まる)。(physics.spaceMesh は全面廃止 —— 移行の写しも退役した。)**(「chainSpreadToy3d を、近似多粒子サンプルのフォーマットに合わせる」): 近似多粒子の契約 physics.approxMany の天体型** —— 中心が支配天体(固定)・粒子 80 は天体(自転のトイの宣言値 0.5〔中心の宣言値の写し・軸は円盤の法線 +z を明示〕と明示半径 √5〔見た目の半径の写し —— 回転引きずりの源になる〕)・粒子どうしの重力と引きずりは残し、接触は切る(本は元から接触なし)。粒子の自転が回転引きずりの源に加わったので帯の数は測り直した(8 条件はすべて満たす —— 散布の種の幅 A 6.2%・B 6.9%・n 160 の差 4.5%)。粒子どうしの重力と引きずりを切った塵型の写しは診断として器で測った(本にしない)。トレイルで、A 側(近似初速の種)の円盤が中心のまわりを回りながら、内帯の粒子が少しずつ先へ引きずられるのを見る(2000 步の Δθ は内/中/外 0.171/0.106/0.103 rad・そのうち移送の分は 0.0110/0.00018/−0.00025)。表示の「空間メッシュ」を ON にすると Z=0 の面の矢印と流線(受動プローブ —— 表示を ON/OFF しても状態は 1 bit も変わらない)。🔗 に比べて連鎖の増幅は小さい(零初速の t=0 直後の接線 u は直接の項の 1.04/1.18/1.07 倍 —— 🔗 は 2.4/6.5/9.7 倍)。ワンタップ対照A/B: B 側は零初速(円盤の初速を 0 —— 中心の自転の回転引きずりだけで回り始め、重力で内へ落ちる: 2000 步で Δr ≈ −0.3)。比べる相手は 🔩(同じ宣言の集まった円盤)と 🔗(二次元)。

descStruct.summary: AN EXPLORATORY COPY OF CHAIN-DRAG EJECTION (a 3D principle sample; laws: the spin dragging A8 and the transport law E6′ in 3D, as 🔩, item 4: the chainDiskToy samples blowing up near step 14000 is interesting - explore an application to a supernova-explosion sample). The 🔗 chainDiskToy disc mostly flies apart near t=250 at the default step (0.016), but that time is brought forward by the app's splitting (gravity kick and drift, then a coordinate-only move u dt) - a coupled rk4 that re-solves the drag at every stage keeps most of the disc bound up to t=480. THE MECHANISM, HOWEVER, SURVIVES IN THE STEP-CONVERGED SOLUTION: particles placed at rest are held in coordinates by the spinning centre and by each other's chained drag, while gravity keeps building their inertial velocity v (booked as the drag's supporting work W). When the clump unbinds, the stored v is released and particles leave at tens of times the escape speed. This sample shows the mechanism with 🔩's centre and a SPHERICAL SHELL r 6-12 of 40 particles (the 🔗 ratios - total mass 4x the centre). The screen step is stepDt 0.002 (a step close to rk4). An ANALOGY of a supernova, not a mechanism sample.
descStruct.observe: Use the trail: the shell stays a clump round the centre (t about 0-210 - only the inertial velocity builds up inside it) and near t=256 most of it flies out in all directions (default step semic, dt 0.002 - 37/40 past radius 100 by t=320 at about 31; the coupled rk4 record is t~272, 37/40 at about 35). In the harness ledger the drag work W builds up and is the ejection budget (initial K+U -56.6 - the ejection kinetic energy comes from W).
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B has the drag off (W_bg not applied - gravity only). On side B the shell collapses and oscillates round the centre; only 3 particles pass radius 100 by close encounters (speed <= 0.8). Compare with 🔗 (the 2D disc - the old split brought the ejection forward at the default step) and 🎇 (a supernova with layered shells - a different mechanism).
